# Ammar Raneez

> Head of Engineering at SoftSora (Colombo, Sri Lanka), working on real-time AI systems, cloud architecture and MLOps. Visiting lecturer in Applied AI at the Informatics Institute of Technology. Author of the Liquid Time-stochasticity (LTS) network, published at IEEE CCWC 2023.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ammarraneez.vercel.app/): a scroll-driven film of the journey, with playable versions of the forecaster, segmentation and real-time call work.
- [Archive](https://ammarraneez.vercel.app/archive): every role, project, tool, award and certificate.
- [Journey](https://ammarraneez.vercel.app/journey): a long-form timeline from 2019 to now.
- [Notes](https://ammarraneez.vercel.app/notes): essays on engineering, AI and work.
- [Case study: real-time AI contact center](https://ammarraneez.vercel.app/work/ai-contact-center)
- [Case study: machine learning in production at 99x](https://ammarraneez.vercel.app/work/ml-in-production)
- [Case study: the LTS network](https://ammarraneez.vercel.app/work/lts-network)
